title: ID0452627-DC/Si-D/DK-[MP/S3 170003353] Zero Sessions on DC1
description:
We need help to identify why there are so many zero sessions on DC1 only. DC2 is running fine.
What can be the reason for this, can we look in the EcoG log in any other way identify the reason.
It is a 5 hour drive to the charger, so we need to have a clear picture before we make the journey to the charger.

additional_info.subject: RE: 0452627 - ID0452627-DC/Si-D/DK-[MP/S3 170003353] Zero Sessions on DC1 CRM:00472000418
additional_info.body:
Hello Rasmus,
You are correct, going back some weeks, we see many failed attempts. It's not single fault, we see failed session in different charging phases.
For what I see the major issue is during P02 Parameter Discovery, and this can be a fault on the ecog but also from the EV.
This case is the EV not requesting to proceed to go for the cable check and we end a session due timeout for this operation.
It's not easy to search now for a past issue. I will close the ticket since we have no activity to do here, if you have again bad performance on this charger let me know so that we can take a immediate actions.
